memtweaks.configuration.voxySectionCache: Recently used world sections Voxy keeps in memory, about 262 KB each. Rejoin the world after changing it.
Keeps one in-memory copy of each jar bundled inside another mod's jar instead of up to three. Applies at the next launch.
memtweaks.configuration.entityTexturesOu: Entity Textures Out of Block Atlas
Stops one mod's atlas file from pulling every mod's entity textures into the block atlas, which doubles its size. Turn off if something shows the missing texture.
memtweaks.configuration.shareIdenticalQu: Keeps one copy of each distinct block model face instead of one per model. Turn off if blocks render with wrong or missing faces.
memtweaks.configuration.reuseModelLocati: Builds Puzzles Lib's list of every block state's model once per resource load instead of once per mod that uses it. Turn off if models from Diagonal Fences, Walls or Windows, Easy Anvils, Easy Magic or Visual Workbench look wrong.
memtweaks.configuration.lazyModelReplace: Applies mods' replace-every-model wrapping when a model is first baked instead of for all of them at startup. Turn off if blocks or items from Create Thrusters, Fetzi's Asian Deco or Display Delight render wrong.
memtweaks.configuration.lazyModelFileEnt: Stops a loop over the model file list from parsing every model file in the game. Turn off if axolotl bucket items show the missing model.
memtweaks.configuration.trustEmfFolderLi: Entity Model Features no longer asks every mod pack about model files its own folder listing didn't find. Turn off if a custom entity model from a resource pack stops showing.
memtweaks.configuration.startupBanner.to: Shows the fractalWARP banner on the first loading screen, and how long the start took on the menu for a few seconds afterwards, when the pack's startup agent is active.
